use_cases: Portfolio or creative work showcase with interactive image reveal on hover
Product gallery with cursor-tracking spotlight effect
Image grid with contextual information display on user interaction
Visual portfolio component for agency or design studio websites
Interactive media gallery with responsive behavior across devices
ai_summary: An interactive image gallery component featuring hover-reveal effects with cursor tracking and spotlight functionality. Displays a grid of images with dynamic reveal behavior, supporting multiple themes (default, blue, green) and sizes. Uses React hooks for state management and includes responsive design with desktop/mobile adaptations.
